case_notes.content:
Session Type: First Case Management Meeting

1. Participant Updates: [Client] reports things are going well; he is staying focused and using 'Thinking for a Change' tools with his girlfriend to manage conflicts. He acknowledges past temptations for 'quick plays' (fast money) but states he is now fully motivated by providing for his kids. Probation is scheduled to end on Feb 18th of next year.
2. Gate & Briefcase Progress:
- Gate 1 (Vital IDs & Health): Verified he possesses ID, SSN, and Birth Certificate. He is covered under Tricare (health insurance) through his father. No current prescriptions.
- Gate 2 (DMV/Housing): Driver's License remains suspended due to a $600 fine. He is actively making payments on this.
- Gate 4 (Education/Employment): Has completed the 'Skillcat' measurements test. Maintains goal to become an electrician/lineman and plans to attend Spartanburg Community College (SCC).
3. Case Plan / CBT Alignment: Discussed relationship dynamics, specifically [Client]'s need for 'space' to de-escalate versus his partner's separation anxiety. Reinforced putting his children's needs before immediate wants.
4. Next Steps / Action Plan:
- Process Goal for Week 1: [Client] will make a payment toward his $600 DMV fine using his Walmart Spark income and bring the receipt to the next CM session.
- CM will assist in researching the SCC Electrician program.

case_notes.content:
Session Type: First Case Management Meeting

1. Participant Updates: [Client] is highly motivated. He previously attended Limestone College on a football scholarship but left after 2 years. He has a federal conviction for mail theft/scamming and a DV charge which he served 90 days for. He is currently supported by his girlfriend and is doing some Walmart Spark driving with her.
2. Gate & Briefcase Progress:
- Gate 1 (Vital IDs): Has Birth Cert, SSN, State ID. Driver's License is suspended due to an outstanding fine of ~$600.
- Gate 2 (Housing/Benefits): Housing is stable (living with girlfriend). Has 1 biological daughter and 1 stepson. No current child support obligations.
- Gate 4 (Education/Employment): Goal is to attend Spartanburg Community College (SCC) for the Electrician program. Previous employment includes Benteler.
3. Case Plan / CBT Alignment: Discussed past triggers ('easy bread' / material things) and ignoring 'red flags' in relationships. [Client] acknowledges needing to put 'needs before wants' to support his children.
4. Next Steps / Action Plan:
- [Client] will research the SCC Electrician program requirements.
- [Client] will begin saving money towards the $600 DMV fine.
- [Client] will maintain perfect attendance/schedule for week 1.
Reached out to Mr. Freeman and scheduled him for orientation this Friday.

Intake Screening: Jayhova Freeman
Date: 10/26/2026 | Center: Spartanburg | Screener: Daisy Boynton

Housing
Lives in an apartment and expects to stay there for the near future.

Documents

Birth certificate: Yes
Social Security card: Yes
State ID: Yes
Driver’s license: Suspended because of one unpaid ticket. He has a car to drive once it's reinstated.

Transportation
His girlfriend will be his main ride. He’ll use Uber as a backup when she can’t drive him. I gave him the center address (111 Belton Drive) and reminded him that relying on Uber gets expensive.

Health & Substance Use

No prescribed medications in the past 5 years.
No emergency or health needs reported.
No history of major alcohol abuse.
Has used marijuana only. I told him the weekly drug test includes marijuana and offered to delay his orientation if needed. He said he’ll pass and noted he’s already drug tested on probation.

Justice Involvement

First arrest at age 22. Arrested twice total, convicted once (the most recent arrest).
Released from county jail about a month ago (around late September 2026) after serving 3 months.
His charge didn’t involve drug trafficking or firearm possession.
No pending charges.
He’s on federal supervision, with a projected end date of 2/18/2027. He reports he’s in full compliance.
Biological parent(s) have a criminal record (he said “pretty sure”).

Family/Financial

Has a child.
Owes no child support.

Education & Employment

Highest education completed: sophomore year of college.
Legally and physically able to work, with no limitations.
Work history:
Bentley Automotive, about 1 year (most recent job). It ended because of incarceration.
Copark (likely Copart), about 3 years (his longest job). He left because he had a child and had to move.
Holds a current cherry picker certification (license card).

Program Fit

He’s available 9–3, Monday through Friday, with no conflicts.
I explained the First Shift structure:
$450/week stipend, with the first payment at the end of week 2.
$9 deducted for each missed point.
Weekly drug testing.
Morning CBT class, then SkillCat training and forklift certification.
Case management throughout.
Job placement after 8 weeks.
He asked what the classes cover, and I answered.

Plan / Next Steps

Added to the waitlist as #2. Orientation call is expected within 1–2 weeks.
Matt or Diyoung will call him. He needs to call back within 24 hours if he misses the call.
Orientation is usually Fridays at 3 PM.
He declined pre-program support (resume, license reinstatement). I’ll update him as his orientation gets closer.
For his case manager: license reinstatement (pay off the ticket) and his interest in automotive/auction-type work.
